text: Lease a Bike is one of the bike-leasing brands of Pon, offered through Pon's Bike Mobility Services business, a joint venture with Volkswagen Financial Services.
short: Lease a Bike is a Pon brand.

source.name: Pon: About us
source.quote: Through our Bike Mobility Services business – a joint venture with Volkswagen Financial Services – and brands such as Lease a Bike and BusinessBike, we've popularized bike leasing
source.note: Sentence continues: '...and supported corporate mobility across Europe.' Pon's company page for the brand (https://www.pon.com/en/companies/lease-a-bike) describes Lease a Bike's leasing platform in six countries.
